usage: agentbreeder secret set [-h] [--state-dir STATE_DIR] [--from-env VAR |
                               --generate] [--env-file ENV_FILE] [--force]
                               name

positional arguments:
  name

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --state-dir STATE_DIR
  --from-env VAR        Read the value from environment variable VAR
  --generate            Store a random hex token
  --env-file ENV_FILE   With --from-env: also look in this KEY=value file
  --force               With --generate: replace an existing secret
